title: Vehicle
description: Standing data about one vehicle, held in the eVault of the vehicle itself. Incident, job and condition records refer to it rather than repeating it. Service history, incident history and condition history are deliberately not fields here: they are separate records pointing back at this vehicle, so the history is append-only and can be written by parties that do not trust each other. A vehicle that does service work (a tow truck, transporter, replacement car or roadside van) is still a Vehicle: its eVault additionally holds a ServiceVehicle record describing that role, and nothing about the vehicle itself is repeated there.

isReference.description: Absent or false on the canonical record in the vehicle eVault; true on a pointer in its driver's eVault, which lets the driver find the car

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the eVault holding this record. For a Vehicle this is the eVault of the vehicle itself.

eName.description: eName of the vehicle eVault, as referenced by every other record in a case

registration.description: Licence plate, normalised without spaces or hyphens

make.description: Manufacturer, as on the registration document

model.description: Model name, as on the registration document

colour.description: Body colour, as a person would describe it, so the vehicle can be recognised at the roadside

weightKg.description: Kerb weight. Decides which recovery equipment is required and which road-section rules apply.

dimensions.description: Millimetres. Constrains transporter slot, and tunnel or bridge access.

widthMm.description: Overall width in millimetres, without mirrors

drivetrain.description: Determines how the vehicle may be towed, where it may be held, and which garages may accept it

transmission.description: Gearbox type. Relevant to whether the vehicle can be towed with its drive wheels on the road.

driveConfiguration.description: Relevant to whether the vehicle can be flat-towed

ownerEName.description: eName of the legal owner: a person, or a lease, rental or fleet company. Often not the driver.

currentDriverEName.description: eName of the person currently assigned to drive the vehicle, where known

keyAccessNotes.description: Key location and access instructions needed for an unattended collection

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
